---
title: "Khud Oss Ne Apna Youn Bhi Shajra Badal Diya"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Yousufi"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Khud Oss Ne Apna Youn Bhi Shajra Badal Diya.
Bad Ghadeer Jis Ne Hai Mula Badal Diya.
Mehboob Se Ali Ki Wilayat Ke Wastey.
ALLAH Ne Ghadeer Mein Lehja Badal Diya.

2
Man Kunto Mula Keh Diya Jab Khud RasooL Ne.
Kehte Ho Kaise Hum Ne Kalma Badal Diya.
Jalte The Kuch Sahabi Haider Se Waise Hi.
Unn Ka Mazeed Rab Ne Jalana Badal Diya.

3
Kuffar Bhi The Hairaan Hijrat Ki Raat Ko.
Misal-e-Nabi Ali Ne Jo Sona Badal Diya.
Shohda-e-Karbala Ko Karte Hain Sab Salam.
Deen-e-Khuda Pe Unn Ne Jo Marna Badal Diya.

4
Hur Se Kaha Hussain Ne Aashor Ki Yeh Shab.
Aye Hur Tumhara Hum Ne Thikana Badal Diya.
Parwardigar Shukar Hai Tu Ne Hai Jo Liya.
Phir Yousufi Ko Oss Se Bhi Acha Badal Diya.

roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for content, numbers in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:

    assert len(blocks) == 4
    for block, number in zip(blocks, numbers):

        assert len(lines) == 5 and lines[0].strip() == number
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in meta and 'noUrdu' not in meta and '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified four matching four-verse stanzas and Urdu metadata.')

Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, adjusting capitalization and removing verse-end periods. Verified that both versions have four matching four-verse stanzas.

Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman alternate title, and removed `noUrdu`. I read “Bad Ghadeer” as `بعد غدیر` and “Aashor” as `عاشور`.
